spriteSpecs.base: Create ONE standalone production game UI background sprite, not a sheet, not a UI mockup. Use supplied reference only for the EXACT visual language of its blank button/panel shapes. It is essential to preserve that hand-inked cut-paper style: very dark plum thick outline, crisp hard lower-right offset ink shadow, thin imperfect inset border, tiny triangular ink flicks at a few corners, very sparse localized halftone dots, matte printed color. Blank uninterrupted interior for the user to place their own icons and localized text in Unity. NO icons, NO text, NO lettering, NO digits, NO locks, NO checkmarks, NO pips, NO meter fill, NO internal compartments, NO extra attached badges, NO scene, NO additional UI. Not glossy, not a metallic frame, not rounded plastic. Front-on 2D, no perspective. Keep 80 percent of interior clean. Crisp high-resolution edges. Entire background outside sprite must be genuine alpha transparency, no opaque backdrop, no checkerboard drawing, no atmospheric glow or blurred shadows. Center the single sprite with about 6 percent transparent safety margin. Reference blue buttons and cream panel are the aesthetic target.
